Gemeinsam mit unseren Experten aus Performance Marketing, CRM, Creative und weiteren Teams stellst du sicher, dass Projekte termingerecht und in höchster Qualität umgesetzt werden.

  • Marketingkonzepte & Entscheidungsgrundlagen: Du übersetzt strategische Ideen in konkrete Projektpläne und entwickelst überzeugende Marketingkonzepte, Pitch Decks, Decision Papers und Briefings. So schaffst du die Grundlage für fundierte Entscheidungen und eine reibungslose Projektumsetzung.

  • Steuerung externer Partner: Du koordinierst unsere Agenturen und Dienstleister, formulierst präzise Briefings, steuerst Feedbackprozesse und stellst sicher, dass alle externen Leistungen optimal mit unseren internen Teams abgestimmt sind.

  • Optimierung unserer Marketingprozesse: Du entwickelst unsere Projekt- und Launchprozesse kontinuierlich weiter. Durch standardisierte Templates, Playbooks und effiziente Workflows sorgst du dafür, dass Marketingprojekte schneller, strukturierter und in gleichbleibend hoher Qualität umgesetzt werden.


Was du mitbringen solltest

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung im Marketing-Projektmanagement: Du hast bereits eigenverantwortlich komplexe Marketingprojekte, Kampagnen oder Produkt-Launches geleitet und kannst konkrete Erfolge anhand messbarer Ergebnisse belegen.

  • Ausgeprägte Projektmanagement-Kompetenz: Du verstehst es, mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig zu steuern, komplexe Vorhaben in klare Arbeitspakete zu strukturieren und unterschiedliche Stakeholder erfolgreich zu koordinieren. Dabei arbeitest du sicher mit klassischen und agilen Projektmanagement-Methoden.

  • Mehrjährige Marketing-Erfahrung: Du verfügst über mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung im Marketing, idealerweise im D2C- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld. Das Zusammenspiel von Performance Marketing, CRM, Content und Conversion ist dir bestens vertraut und du verstehst, wie erfolgreiche Marketingprojekte kanalübergreifend umgesetzt werden.

  • Kommunikationsstärke & strategisches Denken: Du bereitest komplexe Themen verständlich auf, formulierst überzeugende Briefings und Entscheidungsvorlagen und kommunizierst souverän mit internen Teams, Agenturen und dem Management.

  • Hands-on-Mentalität & Eigenverantwortung: Du arbeitest strukturiert, übernimmst Verantwortung und bringst Projekte mit einem hohen Qualitätsanspruch erfolgreich zum Abschluss. Auch in einem dynamischen Umfeld mit wechselnden Prioritäten behältst du den Überblick.

  • Idealerweise Erfahrung im Startup- oder HealthTech-Umfeld: Erfahrungen in schnell wachsenden Startups oder Scale-ups sowie Kenntnisse regulierter Märkte wie HealthTech oder Telemedizin sind ein Plus. Erste Berührungspunkte mit Tools wie Figma oder Adobe sowie ein gutes Gespür für Gestaltung runden dein Profil ab.


Was wir dir bieten

  • Gestaltungsspielraum & Eigenverantwortung: Bringe deine Ideen ein, übernimm Verantwortung und gestalte die Weiterentwicklung unserer Unternehmen aktiv mit.

data.title: Werkstudent:in Softwareentwicklung & IT-Support (Digital Health / Medizin) (All genders)
data.description:
Willkommen im Kumiverse

Gestalte mit uns die digitale Zukunft von Krankenhäusern.

Unsere AI-gestützte Hospital Performance Plattform unterstützt Verantwortliche in Krankenhäusern dabei, komplexe Abläufe transparenter, effizienter und zukunftsfähig zu steuern. Sie entlastet Personal spürbar, hilft, Ressourcen besser zu nutzen und sichert die Qualität der Versorgung in einem System unter Druck, dem AI gerade die größte Chance seit Langem eröffnet.

Klingt spannend? Dann bewirb dich jetzt!


Darum wird es gehen

Als Werkstudent:in Softwareentwicklung & IT-Support arbeitest du an der Schnittstelle zwischen Produktentwicklung und dem stabilen Betrieb unserer Plattform in echten Kliniken. Du bekommst tiefe Einblicke in beide Welten und übernimmst von Anfang an echte Verantwortung. Du übernimmst nicht nur Hilfsarbeiten, sondern arbeitest an Code und Systemen, die in der Patientenversorgung ankommen. Konkret unterstützt du uns dabei,

  • UI-Komponenten unserer klinischen Webanwendung weiterzuentwickeln
  • Server-APIs und Bot-Skripte zu entwickeln und zu pflegen
  • Unit-Tests für Frontend, Server und Datenbank (CouchDB) zu schreiben und anzupassen
  • HIS- und HL7-Schnittstellen sowie kundenspezifische Konfigurationen zu implementieren und zu pflegen
  • Deployments für kundenspezifische Instanzen vorzubereiten und durchzuführen
  • Fehler in produktionsnahen Umgebungen zu analysieren und Bugs zu fixen
  • dabei moderne AI-Tools aktiv als Werkzeug in der Entwicklung einzusetzen
Du arbeitest im agilen Prozess ganz selbstverständlich mit Feature-Branches, Code Reviews und GitLab-Issues, Seite an Seite mit unseren Entwickler:innen und dem IT-Support-Team. In welche Themen du dich stärker vertiefst, richtet sich auch nach deinen Interessen und Stärken.


Was du dafür mitbringen solltest

  • du bist Student:in der Medizininformatik, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Software Engineering oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs
  • erste Programmiererfahrung in mindestens einer Sprache, idealerweise im Web-Umfeld (z.B. JavaScript/TypeScript)
  • Neugierde an Technologie (und besonders an AI) als Chance für eine bessere Medizin, sowie Lust, Neues eigeninitiativ auszuprobieren
  • Affinität zu strukturierten, zuverlässigen Abläufen, gerade wenn es um sensible Daten geht
  • erste Erfahrung im Health-Tech-Umfeld oder in der Krankenhaus-IT ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss
  • Verfügbarkeit für im Mittel mindestens 15 Stunden pro Woche
  • Deutsch beherrschst du fließend in Wort und Schrift
Wichtiger als eine perfekte Checkliste sind uns deine Neugier, deine Lernbereitschaft und dein strukturiertes technisches Denken. In Themen wie HL7-Schnittstellen, NoSQL-Datenbanken oder Deployments kannst du bei uns reinwachsen.


Außerdem arbeitest du gerne

  • eigenverantwortlich, strukturiert und im Team
  • an der Schnittstelle von Softwareentwicklung und praxisnahem IT-Support
  • in einem Start-up Setting mit vielen Entwicklungs- und Aufbaumöglichkeiten
  • an einem sinnvollen Produkt mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch


Was wir Dir anbieten

  • flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, einen Teil deiner Arbeit aus dem Home Office zu erledigen - wir sind uns deiner sonstigen Verpflichtungen als Student:in bewusst
  • die Chance, dich rasant weiterzuentwickeln und echte Verantwortung zu übernehmen
  • die Möglichkeit, von Tag 1 mit modernen AI-Tools in der Entwicklung zu arbeiten und aktiv mitzugestalten, wie wir sie einsetzen
  • Einblicke in beide Welten: moderne Softwareentwicklung und den Betrieb in echten Kliniken
  • Ein ambitioniertes Team, das Begeisterung für den Job teilt und das Wertschätzung gegenüber Kolleg:innen groß schreibt 
  • Ein tolles Büro mit sonnigem Balkon, freien Getränken und Obst zentral im angesagten Hamburger Schanzenviertel
  • Tolle Events und Afterworks

data.title: Working Student Product Management Energy Products & Tariffs (m/f/d)
data.description:
1KOMMA5°

At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it? 

We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market, in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia. 

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Become a part of our mission and learn more about our Product & Tech team!


Deine Position

As a member of our Global Product Management Team for Energy Tariffs, you play an active role in a visionary and dynamic group committed to revolutionizing the global energy sector. Building upon our Heartbeat AI Platform, our mission is to develop energy tariff products across our core markets, take operational and commercial ownership of them, and shape new regulatory products end-to-end. You sit at the center of product, regulation, commercial, and operations, and turn a fast-moving energy market into customer value. In your role you will:

  • Drive Your Own Initiatives: Take ownership of well-scoped topics within our energy tariff portfolio, from analysis to recommendation to implementation. You lead your own initiatives and are accountable for their outcomes.

  • Contribute to Our Energy Tariff Products: Work on our dynamic electricity tariff products across core markets, driving product improvements, feature rollouts, and customer experience initiatives.

  • Support Regulatory Product Launches: Contribute to the launch of new products driven by regulatory change (e.g. Direktvermarktung), helping translate regulatory requirements into concrete product decisions.

  • Analyze & Improve Marktkommunikation Processes: Dive into our market communication workflows, identify inefficiencies, and drive initiatives that make our energy retail engine faster and more reliable.

  • Monitor Performance & Iterate: Leverage customer feedback, competitive analysis, and market trends. Monitor KPIs to help optimize product adoption and overall customer satisfaction.

  • Prepare & Present: Prepare and present findings and recommendations to relevant Product Managers and stakeholders.


Dein Profil

  • You are enrolled at a university for at least two more semesters and can support us 15-20 hours per week during the semester, with up to 40 hours per week during semester breaks

  • You are studying Business, Economics, Engineering, Energy Management, or a comparable course of studies

  • You have a keen interest in the energy market, energy tariffs, and the energy transition, with a strong motivation to drive impactful change

  • You have experience with and enjoy working in Google Sheets/Excel: SQL or Python skills are a plus

  • You are detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable managing multiple projects at the same time

  • You are a problem solver, able to adapt to changing environments and stakeholder needs

  • Previous experience in the energy sector, product management, or consulting is a plus, but we're happy to get you up to speed - motivation counts!

  • Excellent language skills in English and German (both written and spoken)


Benefits

  • You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen

  • With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate

  • Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues

  • You will enjoy direct contact with core decision-makers

  • You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe's most thriving scaleups

  • You can work in one of our offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich

  • Flexible working hours that fit around your university schedule

  • Create a healthy balance alongside your work and enjoy all the benefits of the EGYM Wellpass

  • Benefits and discounts are yours with Futurebens

data.title: Senior IT Operations Specialist (m/f/d)
data.description:
1KOMMA5°

At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?
We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Learn more about our Product & Tech team!


Deine Position

As a Senior IT Operations Specialist, you will be the assigned Tech counterpart for employees, and solve localised problems in our Hamburg HQ. This means that every 1KOMMA5 employee in Hamburg will know you by name, and have trust to include you in all technical discussions that improve their productivity.

The average day of a Senior IT Operations Specialist
The role is divided into 3 key value areas: 

  1. Tech Support on level 1, 2 and 3 tickets created by holding employees. The goal here is to be familiar with stakeholders for faster, more efficient turnaround. Tickets are not escalated, but are triaged and discussed to improve technical understanding and develop. You will also monitor queues for the other markets for urgent out of hours requests, and action them when necessary. Level 1 and 2 tickets may be delegated to working students in the team, with guidance and accountability.
  2. Tech Projects - This refers to projects imposed by Employee Technology Platform product strategy such as rollout of Chrome OS and tool consolidations for the holding. This also refers to inbound projects imposed by holding teams (e.g. tailor onboarding experience, upgrading office infrastructure etc).
  3. Tech Consulting - Providing solutions using existing tools first, through enablement sessions. If no solutions exist, working with teams to technically own and benchmark new applications. There is a particular push to enable AI usage to boost productivity. This means any queries on how to use basic or advanced AI toolings would be directed to this role.


Dein Profil

  • Minimum of 4+ years of proven professional experience in IT systems, systems engineering or a related field.
  • Experience with IT support ticketing best practices, and analysis.
  • Proven ability to work both independently, and as part of a team on Technology related projects.
  • Profound knowledge of Google Workspace, Office 365, Mobile Device Management (JAMF and InTune) and other SaaS applications surrounding employee productivity, collaboration and security.
  • Profound knowledge of AI tooling, specifically relating to employee productivity.
  • Understanding on how to utilize scripting to build bespoke functions. Experience with web-front end HTML, CSS, AppScript, Typescript and Cursor AI
  • Understanding of the workings of cloud infrastructure and code deployment practices and discipline is a huge plus.
  • Generalist knowledge of office infrastructure (e.g. office WLAN, meeting room hardware incl neat).
  • Comprehensive knowledge and proven disciplinary action of domain management
  • Great people skills, being able to persuade and consult non-technical stakeholders on technical solutions.
  • Ability to demonstrate design thinking methodology.
  • Ability to collaborate in a fast-paced, agile environment and adapt to changing priorities while maintaining a security focus.
  • Relevant IT Bachelors or Masters degree. Certifications related to MTD, MAM are a plus!
  • German and English written and verbal communication
  • Willingness to travel, with the most common location being Berlin.


Benefits

  • You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen
  • With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate
  • Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues
  • You will enjoy direct contact with core decision-makers
  • You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe’s most thriving scaleups
  • You work remotely (Germany-wide), with offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich
  • Create a healthy balance alongside your work and enjoy all the benefits of the EGYM Wellpass
  • Benefits and discounts are yours with Futurebens
  • Whether city bike or e-bike - be flexible with our job bike leasing and do something good for the environment at the same time

1KOMMA5°

At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?

We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Learn more about our Product & Tech team!


Deine Position

As the (Senior / Staff) IT Operations Specialist, you will be the assigned Tech counterpart for the holding/central employees at 1KOMMA5.   This means that every 1KOMMA5 employee in the holding will know their Tech Business Partner by name, and have trust to include them in all technical discussions that improve their productivity. You are accountable for the holdings success.

The average day of a (Senior / Staff) IT Operations SpecialistThe role is divided into 3 key value areas

  1. Tech Support on level 1, 2  and 3 tickets created by holding employees. The goal here is to be familiar with stakeholders for faster, more efficient turnaround.  Tickets are not escalated, but are triaged and discussed to improve technical understanding and develop.  You will also monitor queues for the other markets for urgent out of hours requests, and action them when necessary. Level 1 and 2 tickets may be delegated to working students in the team, with guidance and accountability. 

  2. Tech Projects - This refers to projects imposed by Employee Technology Platform product strategy such as rollout of Chrome OS and tool consolidations for the holding. This also refers to inbound projects imposed by holding teams (e.g. tailor onboarding experience, setup n8n flows).

  3. Tech Consulting - Providing solutions using existing tools first, through enablement sessions. If no solutions exist, working with teams to technically own and benchmark new applications.  There is a particular push to enable AI usage to boost productivity. This means any queries on how to use basic or advanced AI toolings would be directed to this role.


Dein Profil

  • Minimum of 10+ years of proven professional experience in IT systems, systems engineering or a related field

  • Experience with IT support ticketing best practices, and analysis

  • Profound knowledge of Google Workspace, Office 365, Mobile Device Management (JAMF and InTune) and other SaaS applications (Zoho CRM is a huge plus) surrounding employee productivity, collaboration and security

  • Understanding on how to utilize scripting to build bespoke functions. Experience with web-front end HTML, CSS,  AppScript, Python and Cursor AI

  • Understanding of the workings of cloud infrastructure and code deployment practices and discipline is a huge plus

  • Generalist knowledge of office infrastructure (e.g. office WLAN)

  • Comprehensive knowledge and proven disciplinary action of domain management

  • Strong people skills, being able to persuade and consult non-technical stakeholders on technical solutions

  • Ability to demonstrate design thinking methodology

  • Ability to collaborate in a fast-paced, agile environment and adapt to changing priorities while maintaining a security focus

  • Relevant IT Bachelors or Masters degree - certifications related to MTD, MAM are a plus

  • German and English written and verbal communication

  • Willingness to travel primarily to 1KOMMA5 the other holding locations (Munich & Hamburg)

Deine Aufgaben

Senior Finance Coordinator & PMO Manager 
(Finance Office Manager) 
About the role 
We are looking for a highly organised, proactive and commercially minded Senior Finance Coordinator & PMO Manager to support and coordinate a broad Finance function of more than 50 colleagues across Accounting, Tax, FP&A, Treasury, Credit Control and related areas. 
This is not a pure administrative role. You will act as the operational backbone of the Finance organisation: ensuring that priorities are clear, deadlines are tracked, meetings result in action, cross-functional projects move forward and the CFO office runs effectively. 
You will work closely with the CFO and senior Finance leaders, combining project management, stakeholder coordination, governance support and hands-on operational follow-up.


Key responsibilities

Finance leadership coordination

  • Support the CFO and Finance leadership team in organising priorities, meetings, decision-making and follow-up.
  • Prepare leadership meetings, agendas, briefing materials and action trackers.
  • Ensure decisions, open points, deadlines and ownership are clearly documented and followed through.
  • Coordinate communication across Accounting, Tax, FP&A, Treasury, Credit Control and other Finance teams.
  • Act as a central point of contact for internal stakeholders on Finance-related coordination topics.

Project and transformation management

  • CoordinateFinanceprojects,includingprocessimprovements,systemsimplementations,reportingenhancements, organisationalchangesandtransformationinitiatives.
  • Maintain project plans, timelines, dependencies, risks, decision logs and status reporting.
  • Challenge delays or unclear ownership constructively and escalate where appropriate.
  • Support project teams in structuring workstreams, preparing workshops and ensuring delivery against agreed milestones.
  • Help turn broad strategic initiatives into clear workplans and practical next steps.

Governance, planning and reporting support

  • Coordinate key Finance calendar activities, including budgeting, forecasting, monthly reporting, audit preparation and year-end processes.
  • Support the preparation and coordination of management presentations, board materials and internal reporting packs.
  • Maintain a clear overview of recurring deadlines, governance requirements and deliverables across the Finance function.
  • Support documentation of Finance processes, policies, responsibilities and decision rights.
  • Assist with the preparation of presentations, summaries and high-quality communication for senior stakeholders.

Operational effectiveness

  • Identify recurring inefficiencies, unclear interfaces or bottlenecks across the Finance organisation.
  • Propose and implement practical improvements to ways of working, communication flows, meeting structures and reporting routines.
  • Establish simple, reliable tools for tracking priorities, projects and commitments.
  • Help create a structured, collaborative and accountable Finance culture.
  • Support onboarding, team events and internal communications where relevant to the Finance organisation.


Dein Profil

  • Several years of experience in a Finance PMO, Finance Business Management, Chief of Staff, consulting, audit, controlling or comparable coordination role.
  • Strong understanding of Finance functions and core processes, ideally including accounting, forecasting, budgeting, audit or reporting cycles.
  • Proven experience managing complex cross-functional projects with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.
  • Excellent organisational skills, with a strong ability to create structure in fast-moving or ambiguous environments.
  • Confident working with senior leaders and able to communicate clearly, diplomatically and assertively.
  • Highly reliable, discreet and comfortable handling sensitive information.
  • Strong PowerPoint, Excel and Microsoft 365 skills; experience with project-management or collaboration tools is an advantage.
  • Fluent English required; German is highly desirable.

What success looks like

Within the first 6–12 months, you will have:

  • Created a transparent Finance leadership and project calendar.
  • Established clear action tracking and follow-up routines across the Finance leadership team.
  • Improved visibility over key Finance projects, risks, dependencies and deadlines.
  • Reduced unnecessary coordination burden on Finance leaders and the CFO.
  • Helped improve collaboration and execution across the wider Finance organisation.
  • Become a trusted point of contact for turning plans and decisions into delivered outcomes.

Personal qualities

You are structured without being rigid, diplomatic without avoiding difficult conversations, and hands-on without losing the bigger picture. You enjoy bringing order to complexity, working with different personalities and ensuring that important work does not get lost between teams.


Warum wir?

What we offer:

  • Opportunity to work with a great team in a dynamic and international environment

  • After successfully passing the probationary period, we offer subsidies for employees’ well-being through our health budget with preventive and aftercare services
  • Various online language courses and opportunities to participate in online collaboration courses
  • Numerous campus events from the fields of art, culture, business and science

data.title: Werkstudent (all genders) – Robuste Feed-Forward-3D-Rekonstruktion für dynamische Szenen
data.description:
Kurzbeschreibung

Feed-Forward-Modelle zur 3D-Rekonstruktion können Szenengeometrie direkt aus Bildern oder Videos vorhersagen, ohne eine aufwendige szenenspezifische Optimierung zu benötigen. Durch die Kombination von großskaligem Pre-Training, Multi-View-Reasoning und starken geometrischen Priors stellen sie eine effiziente Alternative zu klassischen Rekonstruktionsverfahren wie Structure-from-Motion, NeRF und optimierungsbasiertem 3D Gaussian Splatting dar.

Trotz aktueller Fortschritte reagieren bestehende Modelle weiterhin empfindlich auf anspruchsvolle reale Bedingungen. Verdeckungen, bewegte Objekte, wechselnde Beleuchtung, Nachtaufnahmen, Reflexionen, Regen, Nebel und Schnee können zu unvollständiger Geometrie, unzuverlässigen Korrespondenzen und zeitlich inkonsistenten Vorhersagen führen. Eine höhere Robustheit unter solchen Bedingungen ist daher insbesondere für autonomes Fahren und robotische Wahrnehmung von großer Bedeutung.

Als Werkstudent*in unterstützt du die Entwicklung robuster Feed-Forward-Rekonstruktionsmodelle für dynamische Szenen. Du untersuchst Methoden zur Behandlung von Verdeckungen, Beleuchtungsänderungen und widrigen Wetterbedingungen. Darüber hinaus erforschst du, wie große Rekonstruktionsmodelle als universelle geometrische Backbones für nachgelagerte Aufgaben des 3D-Szenenverständnisses eingesetzt werden können, insbesondere für Semantic Occupancy Prediction und 4D Occupancy Forecasting.


Diese Aufgaben interessieren Dich

  • Entwicklung und Evaluation von Feed-Forward-Modellen zur Rekonstruktion dynamischer 3D-Szenen aus monokularen oder Multi-View-Bildsequenzen.
  • Untersuchung der Rekonstruktionsrobustheit bei partiellen und langfristigen Verdeckungen, bewegten Objekten und unvollständigen Beobachtungen.
  • Entwicklung von Methoden zur Verbesserung der geometrischen Konsistenz bei wechselnder Beleuchtung, schlechten Lichtverhältnissen, Schatten und Reflexionen.
  • Evaluation und Verbesserung der Modellleistung unter widrigen Wetterbedingungen wie Regen, Nebel, Schnee und eingeschränkter Sicht.
  • Vergleich der entwickelten Methoden mit relevanten Baselines sowie Dokumentation technischer und experimenteller Ergebnisse.


Das zeichnet Dich aus

  • Du absolvierst gegenwärtig einen Studiengang im Bereich Informatik, Künstliche Intelligenz, Robotik, Elektrotechnik, Data Science oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.
  • Du hast sehr gute Programmierkenntnisse in Python sowie praktische Erfahrung mit PyTorch.
  • Du besitzt ein gutes Verständnis von Computer Vision, Deep Learning, 3D-Geometrie oder Multi-View Vision.
  • Erfahrung mit Tiefenschätzung, Optical Flow, Punktwolken, Kameraposenschätzung, NeRF, 3D Gaussian Splatting oder 3D-Rekonstruktion ist von großem Vorteil.
  • Deine Sprachkenntnisse machen es Dir möglich, deine Rolle auf Englisch (mind. C1-Niveau) auszuüben. Deutschkenntnisse sind wünschenswert, aber nicht zwingend erforderlich.


Gehaltsinformationen

Innerhalb unseres einheitlichen und transparenten Gehaltsframeworks liegt die Vergütung für diese Position zwischen 15,50 € und 19,50 € pro Stunde und orientiert sich an verschiedenen Faktoren, wie Qualifikation und Erfahrung.

Den restlichen Teil deiner Zeit nutzt du, um im Perm-Recruiting beratungsnahe Profile zu gewinnen.


Das gibt es zu tun

  • Du steuerst das Freelance Recruiting im Umfang von ca. 60–70% deiner Tätigkeit
  • Du koordinierst die externe Leistungserbringung: Erstellung von Rahmenverträgen und Einzelabrufen sowie Verlängerungen, Wechsel und Risiken im Projektkontext
  • Du bearbeitest Tickets in Jira im Freelance Recruiting: strukturierte Priorisierung, saubere Dokumentation, Nachverfolgung von Deadlines und Abhängigkeiten sowie Pool-Ausbau und -Pflege
  • Du bist in enger Kommunikation und Abstimmung mit Führungskräften, Sales und Projektmanagement sowie externen Dienstleistungspartnern, um eine bedarfsgerechte Beauftragung sicherzustellen und unsere Delivery zu stärken
  • Du bist Schnittstelle zu Legal und klärst proaktiv Fragen rund um Vertrags- und Compliance-Themen (z. B. Scheinselbstständigkeitsrisiken, Dokumentationsanforderungen)
  • Du treibst die kontinuierliche Prozess- und Qualitätsverbesserung im Freelance Management (z. B. Jira-Workflows, Reportings, Vorlagen/Standards) und setzt Verbesserungen pragmatisch um
  • Du nutzt die verbleibende Kapazität (ca. 30–40%) im Perm Recruiting für beratungsnahe Profile, z. B. im Consulting, Sales sowie für ausgewählte Zentralbereichspositionen


Das bringst du mit

  • Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im Freelance Recruiting bzw. in der Steuerung externer Ressourcen mit (idealerweise im IT-Umfeld)
  • Du hast Jira-Know-how bzw. Routine in der Arbeit mit Ticket-Systemen (Backlog, Statuspflege, Priorisierung, SLA-orientierte Bearbeitung)
  • Du überzeugst durch ausgeprägte administrative Stärke: sehr gute Struktur, Sorgfalt, Verbindlichkeit und Freude an sauberer Prozessarbeit
  • Du hast eine hohe Service- und Stakeholderorientierung und kommunizierst souverän mit Führungskräften, Sales und Projektmanagement – auch bei Zielkonflikten und Zeitdruck
  • Du bringst ein gutes Verständnis von KPIs und Service Level Agreements (SLAs) mit und kannst Durchlaufzeiten und Qualität transparent steuern
  • Du interessierst dich für rechtliche/Compliance-Themen im Kontext externer Zusammenarbeit und bist bereit, dich hier kontinuierlich einzuarbeiten
  • Du arbeitest gerne eng mit unserer Rechts- und Einkaufsabteilung zusammen
  • Du bist lösungsorientiert, kannst gut priorisieren und hast einen pragmatischen Blick dafür, wie Recruiting unsere Delivery bestmöglich unterstützt


Das bieten wir dir

  • Because we care: 30 Urlaubstage und Workation innerhalb der EU schaffen Freiraum für Erholung und neue Perspektiven. So lassen sich Beruf und Privatleben gut miteinander verbinden.
  • Work with us: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, mobiles Arbeiten und Teilzeitmodelle ermöglichen dir, Arbeit und Alltag passend zu gestalten – immer abgestimmt mit deinem Team und deinen Projekten.
  • Learn with us: Mit der ]init[ Academy, Trainings, Zertifizierungen und bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch entwickelst du dich fachlich und persönlich kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Grow with us: Profitiere von bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch und entwickle dich gemeinsam mit deinen Kolleg:innen kontinuierlich weiter.

data.title: Senior AI-Native Fullstack Engineer (m/w/d)
data.description:
Job description

We are building modern, customer-facing software for the temp-staffing industry, integrating capabilities from multiple ERP systems and countries into reliable applications, workflows, services, and reusable platform components.

We are looking for a product-minded senior fullstack engineer who can turn ambiguous business requirements and complex existing systems into production-grade backend services, APIs, integrations, internal tools, and intuitive user interfaces.

TypeScript is central to our technology landscape. Experience with .NET and C# is strongly valued, while engineers with a background in strongly typed languages such as Java are also welcome. Comfort working across different stacks and languages is essential.

AI and LLM tooling are central to how we work. You should use AI-native workflows to explore faster, build in parallel, validate assumptions, and ship high-quality production solutions. You should care about correctness and maintainability, understand integration and business edge cases, choose simple and robust solutions, and own outcomes from exploration to production.


Your tasks

  • Fullstack Product Engineering: Build customer-facing applications, backend services, APIs, internal tools, admin interfaces, automation, job runners, and configurable workflows
  • Backend & Domain Logic: Design maintainable services, APIs, business logic, asynchronous processes, validation rules, and reusable components
  • Frontend Engineering: Build intuitive and maintainable user interfaces using TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks
  • Integrations: Connect applications with ERP systems, internal platforms, external APIs, databases, queues, files, and third-party services
  • Cloud & Production Ownership: Deploy and operate reliable cloud solutions, preferably AWS, owning monitoring, alerts, failure handling, security, performance, cost, and operational reliability


Your profile

  • Hands-on with Claude Code, Codex, and agent-based workflows; GitHub Copilot-style autocomplete alone is not enough
  • Familiar with worktrees, subagents, MCP, structured prompts, harness engineering, parallelization, and validating AI-generated code and analysis to production quality
  • Strong fullstack/backend experience, ideally with .NET and TypeScript
  • Able to build production-grade services, APIs, scripts, tools, automation, and clean interfaces; comfortable with version control, review, debugging, testing, and existing systems
  • Strong understanding of application architecture, API design, domain modeling, integration patterns, asynchronous processing, and maintainable software boundaries
  • Comfortable with SQL, relational databases, schema design, transactions, migrations, indexing, and application-level data access
  • Hands-on with AWS or similar cloud environments, including storage, databases, queues, containers, serverless/scheduled processing, SDKs, and APIs
  • Understands deployment, secrets, networking, permissions, runtime configuration, scalability, performance, cost, and operational trade-offs
You may be a good fit if you are driven to improve how software is built, use AI and agent-based workflows to move faster, experiment with better approaches, and turn ambiguous problems into reliable production solutions. You should enjoy working across the stack, taking ownership beyond predefined tickets, improving existing systems, and rigorously validating AI-generated output rather than accepting it at face value. This role is less suitable for someone who prefers narrow responsibilities, fixed processes, or working within a single technical area without contributing to broader product and engineering outcomes.


Your benefits

  • Work across AI-powered SaaS and cloud-native products, use modern AI tooling daily, and shape pragmatic infrastructure that helps teams ship faster and more safely
  • Collaboration in an empathetic, appreciative team with room to contribute ideas and take ownership
  • Individual development opportunities, structured onboarding, and interdisciplinary collaboration
  • Flexible working models including hybrid work, home office, and mobile working
  • A modern tech environment and agile ways of working
  • Additional benefits such as pension plans, health offers, and employee discounts

data.title: Enterprise Account Executive (EMEA FSP 2)
data.description:
Who We Are; What We Do; Where We’re Going
 
Magnet Forensics is a global leader in the development of digital investigative software that acquires, analyzes, and shares evidence from computers, smartphones, tablets, and IoT-related devices. We are continually innovating so our customers can deploy advanced and effective tools to protect their companies, communities, and countries.
 
Serving thousands of customers globally, our solutions are playing a crucial role in modernizing digital investigations, helping investigators fight crime, protect assets, and guard national security.
 
With employees based around the world, Magnet Forensics has been expanding our global presence. As a part of Magnet Forensics, you can expect to make a difference in the world, no matter what role you play. You’ll be supported through learning and development, not to mention an incredible team with unbelievable talent and integrity.
 
If you think you would be the right person to join our team working towards this goal, we would love to hear from you! 

Role Overview 

Magnet Forensics is seeking a high-performing Enterprise Account Executive to drive new business growth across the  European (excluding United Kingdom and Ireland) forensic service provider market (EMEA FSP 2)
 
This role is focused on building pipeline, acquiring strategic new enterprise customers, and expanding adoption across corporate and private-sector organisations. The successful candidate will demonstrate a proven ability to independently develop territory strategy, create opportunities, and own complex enterprise sales cycles end-to-end using a MEDDPICC-driven sales approach, in addition to handling high volumes of smaller, transactional type sales which involve a rapidly moving sales cycle.
 
As a key member of Magnet Forensics’ EMEA team, you will operate with significant ownership of the EMEA FSP 2 region, working closely with partners located across Europe, marketing, dedicated sales development representative (SDR), sales engineering, and leadership to establish and scale market presence.
 

This role is best suited to candidates motivated by long-term territory development and market ownership rather than short-term account management or inherited revenue.

Candidate must reside in Germany

What You’ll Do

Sales Execution & Territory Ownership

  • Develop and execute a territory plan focused on pipeline creation, new logo acquisition, and predictable revenue growth across the European forensic service provider market.
  • Own the full enterprise sales cycle from prospecting and discovery through commercial negotiation and close.
  • Maintain strong pipeline coverage aligned to quarterly and annual revenue targets.
  • Engage executive stakeholders and decision makers within enterprise organizations.

    • MEDDPICC Deal Execution

    • Apply MEDDPICC rigorously to qualify opportunities, access economic buyers, build champions, multithread, and drive forecast accuracy.
    • Navigate complex multi-stakeholder enterprise sales environments and long sales cycles.
    • Maintain disciplined opportunity management and forecasting practices.

      • Market Expansion

      • Drive market penetration through outbound prospecting, executive networking, and partner collaboration.
      • Acquire new enterprise logos while expanding strategic existing accounts.
      • Identify and develop growth opportunities within key verticals and regulated industries.

        • Partner & Ecosystem Engagement

      • Work closely with regional partners and resellers to generate pipeline and execute joint sales strategies.
      • Enable partners through joint account planning, opportunity alignment, and customer engagement activities.

        • Marketing & Industry Engagement

        • Collaborate with marketing to support regional campaigns, events, and demand generation initiatives. This will sometimes involve collaborating with partners.
        • Represent Magnet Forensics at industry events, conferences, and customer engagements across Europe.

          • Customer Engagement

          • Act as a trusted advisor to customers by understanding investigative, cybersecurity, and digital forensics challenges.
          • Deliver solution-led sales engagements aligned to customer outcomes and business value.

What We’re Looking For
  • 4+ years of enterprise sales experience within SaaS, Cybersecurity, DFIR, or adjacent technology markets.
  • Proven track record of acquiring new enterprise customers and consistently exceeding revenue targets. Demonstrated ability to generate pipeline through outbound prospecting, partner engagement, and executive networking.
  • Experience managing both complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles and shorter sales cycles and executive with efficiency and precision.
  • Strong experience applying MEDDPICC (or equivalent) sales methodology.
  • Experience working with both direct and partner-led sales models.
  • Self-starter with the ability to operate independently in a developing region.
  • Comfortable working across international teams and time zones.
  • Strong commercial acumen with excellent negotiation and executive communication skills.
  • Highly organized with disciplined forecasting and pipeline management practices. Entrepreneurial mindset with a proactive, ownership-driven approach to territory growth.
  • Fluency in German and English (written and spoken).
  • Meticulous with a strong eye for administrative detail – certain products sold by the EMEA FSP team have a heavily involved approval process where this trait is a must.
    •  

    What Success Looks Like in This Role
  • Build and develop a sustainable enterprise pipeline across the European forensic service provider market through proactive prospecting, partner engagement, and executive relationship development.
  • Establish Magnet Forensics as a trusted investigative technology partner within strategic enterprise accounts.Consistently progress opportunities through structured discovery, value alignment, and MEDDPICC-driven execution.Deliver predictable revenue performance while contributing to long-term regional market growth.

    • Compensation & Benefits 

    The Compensation range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. Please note that the actual compensation may vary depending on location and job-related factors such as qualifications, experience, knowledge and skills. If you are applying for this role outside of the primary location and you are selected for an interview, the Talent Acquisition Partner can share more information with you.  If the compensation structure for the role includes an incentive component (i.e. most Sales roles) the range below represents total target compensation (TTC) (base salary + variable).
     

    €94,100 – €134,000 (EUR) a year

    Salary range (min - max)
     

    Position Type: Current Vacancy 

     


    Magnet is proud to offer benefits such as: 
     
    - Generous time off policies 
    - Competitive compensation 
    - Volunteer opportunities  
    - Reward and recognition programs   
    - Employee committees & resource groups  
     
    Indicators of Success
     
    We’re looking for someone who checks off most, but not all, of the boxes listed in “skills and experiences”.  It’s more important to us to find candidates who can display indicators of success through skills they have developed and experiences they have been a part of, than to find folks who have “been there, done that”.  We want to be part of your development journey, and we’ll learn as much from you as you learn from us. 
     
    How We Work
     
    At Magnet Forensics, we take a hybrid-flexible approach to support your productivity and work-life balance. If you’re within a comfortable travel distance to one of our offices, you’ll occasionally join us in person. How often you’ll come in depends on your department and team needs, typically ranging from weekly to monthly. These in-person moments help us build stronger connections, spark new ideas, and celebrate our successes together. Most days, you can choose what works best for you, while staying in tune with your team’s goals.
     
    We’re excited to welcome you to our team and look forward to achieving great things together - both in the office and wherever you work best!
     
    The Most Important Thing
     
    We’re looking for candidates that can provide examples of how they have demonstrated Magnet CODE in their previous experiences:
     
    CARE – We care about each other and our mission to make a difference in the world.
    OWN – We are accountable for our results – while never forgetting to act with integrity, empathy, and respect.
    DEDICATE – We put our heart and soul into meeting the needs of our customers and helping them serve the people they protect.
    EVOLVE – We are constantly innovating and exploring new ways to work together to make an impact with our work.
     
    Here at Magnet Forensics, we are committed to continuous learning and are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. This commitment will be reflected in our hiring processes and embedded in our values and how we treat one another. If you’re interested in this role, but do not meet all of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply anyways.
     
    Magnet Forensics is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law. We are committed to providing an inclusive, accessible recruitment process and work environment. Accommodation is available to all applicants upon request throughout the hiring process. Please contact
     
    All offers of employment at Magnet are contingent upon satisfactory completion of a background check. All background checks will be conducted in accordance with all applicable laws. Magnet will consider each position’s job duties, among other factors, in determining what constitutes satisfactory completion of the background check. Refusal to consent to a background check may be grounds for revoking an offer of employment.
     
    US Applicants: Magnet Forensics participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.
     
    Magnet Forensics handles and uses personal data of job applicants in line with its Recruitment Privacy Policy found here.

We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the team

In our Professional and Financial Services Business unit, we bring everything we have learned in more than a decade of Applied AI, and use it to help our clients navigate a rapidly changing landscape.

We develop and embed AI solutions which help firms become more efficient, enhance customer experience, and find the commercial upside in uncertain markets. Within the constraints of a highly regulated industry, we see so much opportunity for meaningful innovation and are proud to set the gold-standard for marrying technical excellence with safe deployment.

About the role

Banking is entering a period of profound reinvention. Across retail, commercial and corporate banking, leaders are under pressure to improve productivity, modernise customer journeys, strengthen risk management, and turn AI from a series of pilots into enterprise-wide advantage.

Faculty is uniquely placed to help. We combine deep technical expertise in AI with hard-won experience delivering real transformation in complex, regulated environments. We work with senior leaders to move beyond experimentation, designing and deploying AI solutions that create measurable impact across front office, operations, risk, and control functions.

We’re looking for a Head of Banking to define and grow our presence in the sector. You will shape our go-to-market strategy, build enduring relationships with senior banking stakeholders, and lead the pursuit and delivery of some of the most ambitious AI transformation programmes in the market.   • Generating sales and revenue for Faculty by shaping software design, compelling commercial pitches, and exciting demos that convey Faculty’s technical depth and delivery excellence

  • Mentoring and developing colleagues through line management, helping to replicate and reinforce Faculty’s Principles and collegial culture

Who we're looking for

  • You bring deep knowledge of banking, having worked in industry - preference for corporate and business banking experience

  • You are passionate and enthusiastic about the way AI can deliver better outcomes for banking customers

  • You have a well-developed and distinct point of view on how banks should adopt AI, and how AI will impact the industry

  • You've led large, complex transformation programmes, ideally involving organisational change with data, technology, or AI, for a bank or as a consultant

  • You are commercially minded - excited about hitting commercial targets through shaping opportunities, winning work, growing accounts, and owning meaningful revenue responsibility

  • You are a compelling communicator who builds trust quickly with senior stakeholders and can explain complex technologies clearly

  • You are comfortable switching altitudes - from executive level to delivery to challenge constructively, unblock teams, and maintain quality

  • You have experience leading, mentoring, and developing high-performing teams, and you care about building an inclusive, intellectually rigorous culture

  • You bring relevant academic or professional grounding in finance, economics, or a related field

Our Interview Process

Talent Team Screen (40 mins)

Introduction Interview (40 mins)

Sector Interview with MD Applied AI and Professional and Financial Services Director (90 mins)

Executive Interview with Chief Commercial Officer (45 mins)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

Some of our standout benefits:

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. data.description:
KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is the world’s leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We’re also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

KAYAK is seeking a Conceptual Designer to join a newly forming creative hub in London covering UK and EMEA. We’re looking for a modern, multidisciplinary designer with a strong eye for art direction, who’s immersed in the design world and the latest trends. You’ll be the visual engine behind London’s studio, bringing bold, beautifully crafted ideas to life across brand campaigns, OOH, social media, and short-form content.

You're a designer who can set a creative vision, and then happily get on the tools to make it real. Comfortable working solo or in collaboration with writers, editors and production partners. You’ll ideally come from a creative agency, or in-house background, with a portfolio that clearly demonstrates your taste for design, art direction and passion for visual storytelling across all formats.

This role is based in our London office 3 times a week.

In this role, you will:

  • Conceive and develop original visual concepts for multi-channel campaigns — from OOH and social media to short-form video — ensuring each idea is tailored to the format, audience, and communication objective.

  • Own the visual direction of creative work from initial concept through to final execution, maintaining the integrity of the idea across production, iteration, and adaptation.

  • Partner closely with a Conceptual Copywriter to build an integrated creative hub in London, developing ideas together from the earliest stages of ideation.

  • Translate briefs, brand strategy, and cultural insight into visually compelling concepts that cut through in a crowded category — work that earns attention and drives results.

  • Bring a strong aesthetic sensibility and taste level to every project, setting a high bar for visual quality and pushing the work beyond the expected.

  • Present and defend creative concepts to stakeholders with clarity and confidence, articulating the thinking behind visual decisions and remaining open to feedback.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with video editors, campaign managers, and performance marketers to ensure creative concepts are both ambitious and executable within real-world constraints.

  • Contribute actively to concept sessions — bouncing ideas, building on others' thinking, and helping the wider team unlock stronger creative directions.

  • Leverage AI tools for rapid concept development, moodboarding, storyboarding, and visual exploration — using them resourcefully to do more with less, without compromising taste or craft.

  • Stay curious about emerging creative technologies, cultural trends, and visual storytelling formats, bringing fresh perspectives and references into the team's creative process.

Please apply if you are:

  • 5-7+ years into your creative career as a Designer or Art Director, with strong thinking, craft, and a portfolio that shows what you can do, rooted in campaign work and not purely product or UI design.

  • Deep knowledge of advertising formats and how visual ideas must be tailored — not just adapted — to work across OOH, social media, and short-form content.

  • Strong aesthetic sensibility and taste — you have a clear visual point of view and know how to push creative work further within them.

  • Proficiency in design tools such as Figma and the Adobe Creative Suite; experience with motion graphics or video editing is a strong plus.

  • A collaborative, ego-free mindset — you're a natural creative partner who gives and receives feedback constructively, understands that great work serves business and communication goals, and thrives in a cross-cultural team environment.

  • Confidence presenting and defending ideas — you can pitch a visual concept clearly to stakeholders and adapt it with grace when the brief evolves.

  • Curiosity about AI as a creative tool — you're open to using generative AI for ideation, moodboarding, and rapid concept exploration, with the taste and judgment to know when it enhances the work.

  • Experience with cinematography, film production, or motion design is a plus — an understanding of how visual ideas translate to moving image is valued.

Benefits and Perks:

  • 5 weeks of paid vacation

  • Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday

  • Private health & dental insurance

  • Income protection and life assurance

  • Pension plan contributions

  • Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year

  • Focus on mental health and well-being:

    • Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth

    • Company-paid subscription to Headspace

    • Company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)

  • No meeting Fridays

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid volunteer time

  • Focus on your career growth:

    • Development Dollars

    • Leadership development

    • Access to thousand of on-demand e-learnings

  • Travel Discounts

  • Employee Resource Groups

  • Employee Assistance Program - including 24/7 GP & free legal advice

  • Discounted gym membership

  • Bike2Work

  • Season ticket loan

  • Social events & Thursday happy hours

  • Free lunch 2 days per week

 

Inclusion

At KAYAK, we want everyone to have the space to grow, share ideas and do great work. That’s why we’re focused on hiring the best talent from all walks of life and experiences, supporting them well and making sure no one feels like they have to fit a mold to belong here.

Juro has big ambitions: to become the go-to platform for agreeing and managing contracts globally. And we'll need help doing it.

Legal tech is on the rise, with Goldman Sachs estimating that 44% of legal tasks can be automated with generative AI. With the brand we have built and the agility of early stage we are well placed to capture this opportunity.

 

Signing a contract is the easy part. Everything before it (multiple parties, several legal documents, opposing interests, a redlining process most companies still run through email attachments) is where contracting actually gets hard.

That's the part of Juro you'll own. It's the most ambitious area of the product and the one with the most room to change how contracting feels for the people doing it day to day.

We're not handing you a blank page. There's a roadmap in place and a team ready to build it. We want you shipping against it while you're forming your own view of the problem, then tell us which parts of it were wrong.

Every PM at Juro is hired to make product bets that pay out. Great means that:

  1. the bets you own deliver real outcomes for customers quickly, and

  2. those outcomes show up in revenue.

What you're here to do:

  • Ship against the contract workflow roadmap in your first few weeks.

  • Get close to the problem rapidly. Talk to customers and prospects yourself. Form your own view of the jobs to be done rather than inheriting ours.

  • Take on AI review. It's a deep agentic system (evals, flows, failure modes) and "good redline" isn't a pass/fail, which is what makes it hard. It also spans your team and our Agentic team, so some of what you own won't sit neatly in one place.

  • Work shoulder to shoulder with engineering, design and GTM to turn all of that into something people actually enjoy using.

  • Measure whether any of it worked and be honest when it didn't. Iterate or pivot when necessary.

Six months in, success looks like customers telling us unprompted that contracting in Juro got a lot more delightful and reaching for it in places they used to reach for Word.

 

We care about building a diverse team where everyone feels they belong. That’s why our perks & benefits and choice-first work approach are designed with inclusivity in mind. Read more in our diversity, inclusion & belonging hub.

 
 

WHO WE LOOK FOR

 

Research shows that while men apply to jobs if they meet ~60% of criteria, women and those in traditionally under-represented groups tend to apply only if they check all boxes. So if you think you have what it takes but don't meet every single point above, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit.

 

To succeed here:

Every Juror finds their balance across our four core principles — we hire, develop and celebrate people who live them every day.

Curious how you’d fit? Try our personality quiz to see how you map against our principles.

On top of that, you have been part of a journey where:

  • You've landed in a domain you knew nothing about and were making judgment calls within weeks. Ideally more than once.

  • You've owned something complex and multi-quarter from discovery through launch and iteration + were accountable when it slipped.

  • You've worked shoulder to shoulder with GTM and engineering through launches + have been the trusted go-to person for them in past companies.

  • You understand why evals matter and how agentic loops work.*

  • You run your own discovery. Customer calls, prospect calls, synthesising messy qualitative input into a clear view of what to build.

  • You've brought ideas unprompted and built them without waiting for permission. Something small shipped in days beats a perfect spec written in weeks.

  • BONUS #1: You've owned the quality of an agentic system in production.

  • BONUS #2: Legal tech or contracting experience.

*What we care about is that you will dig into how a system actually behaves when you need to: work out why a flow is producing rubbish, go back and forth with engineers until it isn't. You don't need to have done this full time.

This job likely isn’t for you if:

  • You need someone to teach you the domain before you can be useful.

  • You think of AI as something the engineers deal with.

  • You want a settled team and a clean remit. Our product org will change, and some of your scope will cut across other teams.

  • You'd want to spend your first quarter rewriting the roadmap before shipping any of it.

  • You'd rather run the process than talk to customers.

  • You've been managing PMs and want to carry on doing that. This is hands-on.

 
 

OUR MISSION

Juro exists to help the world agree faster by making it incredibly easy for anyone to agree and manage legal contracts.

Frustrated by the absurdly slow process of taking a contract from inception through to agreement, Juro co-founders Richard and Pavel thought there must be a better way. They set out in 2016 to build a flexible, collaborative platform that anyone could use to process a legal contract end-to-end in their browser.

Fast forward 8 years and we have helped our customers process 2 million contracts in over 85 countries. Some of the world’s fastest-growing businesses, like Deliveroo, Remote, and Trustpilot have relied on Juro to help them streamline routine contracts at scale across multiple years of their growth.

data.description:
Tessl is a fast-growing Series A startup based in London, founded by Guy Podjarny. We’ve raised over $100M from world-class investors including Index Ventures, Accel, GV, and Boldstart, and in 2025 we were ranked #2 in Sifted EU’s B2B SaaS Rising 100 and #20 in Sifted's AI 100.

At Tessl, we are building the context layer for AI coding agents, and a platform for AI-native software development. As an early member of the team, you’ll help shape how we build, scale and support a company operating at the edge of AI and software development.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Content ships fast across engineering, marketing, community, and DevRel. This role is the connective tissue that makes that possible: owning the comms calendar, publishing content, coordinating creative assets and social comms, moderating comments in channels like YouTube, and making sure content reaches the channels and communities where our audience is. This is a 6-month fixed-term contract (FTC).

This is an execution and coordination role, and a great entry point into B2B marketing at an AI-native company. It also includes building automations for this work using Tessl's own Dark Factory, with support from our GTM engineer, so repeatable production tasks get systemized rather than repeated by hand.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Content calendar & publishing workflow

  • Own the content calendar end to end and keep it current after every planning meeting

  • Coordinate the publishing pipeline: chase drafts, request design assets with adequate lead time, and hold authors accountable to deadlines

Publishing & distribution

  • Own the social media calendar and publish posts (LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Reddit, Discord) using pre-generated copy and UTM links.

  • Publish videos to YouTube with pre-written descriptions and links; manage thumbnails and playlist placement.

  • Cross-post published content to branded third-party channels (Reddit, Hacker Noon, Dev.to) with canonical backlinks and UTM tracking, following the existing UTM taxonomy.

  • Build and maintain an automation that surfaces relevant developer community threads (Reddit, Hacker News) and drafts contextual posts back to published content, pushing them to Slack in real time so DevRel and community-trusted individuals can review and post under their own name, this role builds the surfacing and drafting mechanism.

  • Produce a monthly developer-community signal report (notable threads, questions, sentiment) for DevRel, Product, Marketing, and Sales, which will become an automated workflow feeding the same real-time Slack surfacing above.

Moderation & community response

  • Respond to comments and questions on social and YouTube (triage or use internal tooling)

  • Moderate comments across channels: remove spam/abuse, flag anything sensitive or reputationally risky before responding (auto-hide is enabled for malicious comments)

  • Pull noteworthy comments, questions, and feedback into Slack weekly, so the team sees what the audience is saying without reading every thread themselves

Cross-team production support

  • Pick up ad hoc marketing production requests (design briefs, YouTube channel merchandising, banner requests) so they don't fall to senior team members

  • Flag blockers and surface feedback across content, growth, and product marketing to keep the team aligned

Workflow automation

  • Identify manual, repeatable tasks in the production pipeline and build lightweight automations or Claude skills for them

WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE

  • Publishing runs on schedule with few follow-ups needed

  • Authors and stakeholders get consistent, visible accountability through one shared channel

  • Distribution reach (impressions, upvotes, referred traffic) grows month over month against a shared baseline

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Must have:

  • Strong written English and good judgment on public tone, since comment moderation and response require calling the right register in public

  • Comfortable working across functions without a fixed lane; this role touches content and growth in the same week

  • Comfortable navigating LinkedIn, X, Reddit, and YouTube Studio day to day

  • Has used AI and can demonstrate a workflow or application you’ve built

Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with Reddit/Hacker News community norms

  • Basic Notion/Linear fluency

  • Some comfort with no-code or lightweight scripting for internal tooling

No marketing strategy experience required, this is an entry-level role, well suited to an early-career marketer, a career switcher, or someone returning to work after a break.

SALARY AND BENEFITS

Office: Our brand new 10,000 sq. ft office is in the AI hub of Kings Cross, London. We have generous catering and regular social events such as team lunches, drinks, and more. We require all staff to be in our London HQ at least 3 days a week on our anchor days of Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday.

Salary: We offer a competitive salary based on experience and skills, benchmarked against industry standards and appropriate for an entry-level/apprenticeship position.

Benefits: 25 days holiday, health insurance including dental and vision (extends to partners and dependents), and a company-matched pension. We also provide a commuting stipend for those who live outside London, and a Cycle to Work scheme.

APPLICATION PROCESS

  1. Introductory call

  2. Hiring manager deep dive

  3. Practical exercise (content/publishing task)

  4. Final conversation with the marketing team

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every requirement. We care about talent, trajectory, and mindset, not just checkboxes.


We care deeply about the warm, inclusive environment we’re building at Tessl and we value diversity – we welcome applications from those typically underrepresented in tech. If you like the sound of this role but are not totally sure whether you’re the right person, do apply anyway!

data.description:
Tessl is a fast-growing Series A startup based in London, founded by Guy Podjarny. We’ve raised over $100M from world-class investors including Index Ventures, Accel, GV, and Boldstart, and in 2025 we were ranked #2 in Sifted EU’s B2B SaaS Rising 100 and #20 in Sifted's AI 100.

At Tessl, we are building the context layer for AI coding agents, and a platform for AI-native software development. As an early member of the team, you’ll help shape how we build, scale and support a company operating at the edge of AI and software development.

Overview of the role

We're hiring a Research Engineer to join our AI Research (AIR) team. You'll work on the components that make the outer loop real: how agent harnesses orchestrate model behaviour, how we evaluate what's actually working, how pipelines turn production traces into the next round of improvement, and how we diagnose the failure modes that matter to real users.

These aren't four separate workstreams — they're parts of one system, and we want people who see them that way.

We expect you to sit close to customers — joining calls, watching sessions, reading traces — and to let real workflows shape your research priorities. You'll have meaningful autonomy and the resources to run substantial experiments where the bar for success is shipped impact.

You'll report to our AI Research Lead, and collaborate closely with engineering, product, and design.

What we're looking for

We're explicitly building coverage across four skill areas. You don't need to be strong in all of them — but you should bring depth in at least one:

  • Agent harness and orchestration design — how tools, context, and control flow combine to make a useful agent.

  • Agentic eval methodology — task and repo-level evals, dataset curation, the craft of measuring what actually matters.

  • Outer-loop and pipeline thinking — feedback loops, training-data flywheels, bandit-style optimisation, anything that goes beyond a single agent session.

  • Failure-mode analysis — instrumenting agents, reading traces at volume, surfacing patterns engineering can act on.

Essential

  • 4+ years shipping AI/ML products in a startup or applied industry setting, with recent hands-on experience with LLMs and agentic systems.

  • Demonstrated depth in at least one of the four skill areas above.

  • Strong product and customer instincts: comfort joining customer calls, watching session recordings, and letting real workflows shape what you work on.

  • Sharp evaluation judgement: benchmarks where they exist, vibes and quick prototypes where they don't, and the taste to know which is appropriate.

  • Experience building datasets for evaluation or training, including the pipeline work that goes with it.

  • Deeply curious about agents and excited about reshaping how software is built.

Nice to have

  • A Masters or PhD in a relevant computational field.

  • Direct experience with coding agents or code-generation systems.

  • Background in RL, bandits, or other outer-loop optimisation frameworks applied to LLMs.

  • Experience building synthetic data, dataset infrastructure, or internal tooling that other engineers actually used.

  • A project you can show us (GitHub links welcome) and a thoughtful answer to "Why Tessl?"

What you'll do

No two weeks will look the same. A flavour:

  • Sit in on a customer session, understand how their agents are failing, design an eval that captures it, and drive a fix through to shipped improvement.

  • Close a piece of the outer loop end to end: production signal in, dataset out, eval scored, harness change shipped, metric moved.

  • Own a slice of our eval infrastructure: dataset curation, harness configuration, runner, analysis, and the comms back to engineering.

  • Prototype a new harness or context configuration and measure whether it actually moves the needle on real customer tasks.

  • Dig through pages of agent traces, build the tooling you need to make sense of them, and brief the team on what you found.

  • Partner with product and engineering on near-term shipping problems by bringing research rigour.

  • Pull a recent paper apart, work out what's actually transferable to our platform, and turn it into a concrete experiment.

You’ll be successful if…

In your first 3 months, you might have shipped a new eval suite for a real customer workflow, improved an agent harness based on trace analysis, or built a pipeline that turns production failures into reusable test cases.

Salary and benefits

Competitive salary commensurate with experience. Health insurance extending to partners and dependents, pension contributions, and the rest of what you'd expect.

Our office is a couple of minutes from King's Cross — pet friendly, with regular team lunches, drinks, and socials. We're hybrid, with Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday as the primary in-office days.

  • Intro call to understand "Why Tessl?" and to tell you a bit about us.

  • A call with our AI Research Lead to understand your ways of working and how you use agents.

  • A 4 hour technical take-home exercise extending our one-shot implementation.

  • A half-day on-site session including whiteboarding and hands-on activities.

  • Leadership chats with our Head of People, Head of Engineering and CEO.
